verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a standalone terminal option pitched as 'the quickest way to accept in-person payments'. It also lets merchants manage terminals from the Customer Area and markets 'get started fast' terminals, so the core idea of getting a reader running is supported. However, no evidence describes the actual pairing, boarding or registration flow, or shows it can be done in minutes. Missing for 10: documented reader pairing/registration steps, evidence of time-to-first-payment within minutes, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can pair a card reader with the POS app or register it to my account and take a payment within minutes

citations.quote: want the quickest way to accept in-person payments, we also offer a standalone terminal solution
